candidates.title: Telangana employees’ JAC to continue stir, says agitation only paused
candidates.excerpt: The Telangana Employees Joint Action Committee (TG EJAC) has clarified that its agitation over employees’, teachers’ and pensioners’ demands has only been paused temporarily and will resume in a phased manner.

candidates.title: Israeli opposition leaders sign pact to replace Netanyahu
candidates.excerpt: Tel Aviv: Five Israeli opposition leaders have signed a joint pact to coordinate their efforts ahead of the October 27 Knesset election and seek to replace Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s government.
